summary.headline: Review of el- after the toolbox words: a8lab, nafs, taani, awal, aa5er, 8eir

rules.title: a8lab and nafs go before the noun, and the noun after them takes el-
bullets: Never el- on a8lab or nafs itself
The noun after them always takes el- (never 'a8lab min')
No el- when the noun has a pronoun ending: a8lab wa2ti

examples.line: أغلب وقتي - most of my time
a8lab el-muwazzafeen fi ma7alli maxiciyeen - most employees in my store are Mexican
e7na bnekrah nafs el-ash5aas - we hate the same people
ana u abuy beneshte8el fi nafs el-ma7al - my dad and I work in the same store
a8lab el-3arabyeen nafs el-ishi - most Arabs are the same

rules.title: An idafa pair counts as one noun: a8lab aa5er el-usboo3, not a8lab el-aa5er
bullets: aa5er el-usboo3 (the weekend) is already a joined pair
Treat it as one noun: no extra el- after a8lab
Adding el- would break the idafa rule

examples.line: a8lab aa5er el-usboo3 ru7na 3ala el-shatt - most weekends we went to the beach

rules.title: taani, awal, aa5er, kul go before the noun with no el-
bullets: Before the noun: no el- on the noun
awal yoami = the start of my day; kul yoami = my whole day
taani can be plural after a noun: s7aabek el-tanyeen

examples.line: a3tini 2amees taani - give me another shirt
7abbait taani badle - I liked the second suit
awal yoami kaan sayyi2 - the start of my day was bad
kul yoami kan beyza33el - my whole day was saddening
taani ijtimaa3 kaan nafs awal waa7ad - the second meeting was the same as the first
s7aabek el-tanyeen 8eir 3an hadoal - your other friends are different from these

rules.title: After the noun they are adjectives: el-noun el-a5ira / el-oola
bullets: aa5er before the noun; a5ir / a5ira after it
awal becomes oola (fem.) after the noun
Adjective after a definite noun takes el- too

examples.line: 7abaiti el-badle el-oola - you liked the first suit
el-kundara el-a5ira kaanat bish3a - the last shoes were ugly
يومي الأول، يومي الثاني، يومي الأخير - my first, second, last day

rules.title: 8eir before the noun = another; 8eir 3an = different from
bullets: 8eir akle = another dish (before the noun is the usual order)
8eir 3an = different from; more casual than mukhtalif 3an

examples.line: ana biddi 8eir akle - I want another dish
مختلف عن و غير عن - different from
